proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive magic-weapon rider changes this weapon's hit damage from one type to another, which is neither a numeric modifier nor a standalone damage instance.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor.line_to_target
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation's area is a 5-foot-wide line whose length is the distance from the thrower to the chosen target, capped at 120 feet; the existing line shape only supports a fixed length.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target.

proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation deterministically moves the thrown weapon back to the wielder's hand after damage resolves, and the current surface has no honest item-return effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: Top-level fit is a composite magic item (passive rider plus once-per-dawn activation), but I did not author Dhall because the passive damage-type swap and the target-bounded line are both missing. A partial encoding would under-specify one of the item's two core mechanics.
